name: pixel-pet
description: A pixel-art Saiyan above the prompt: the model picks the fighter, the effort its Super Saiyan form, and it reacts to prompts, tool calls, errors and finished turns, firing its signature beam when a turn ends

name.title: Pet name
name.description: The name shown beside the pet; empty shows the fighter's own name

character.title: Character
character.description: auto follows the model: Opus is Goku, Sonnet Vegeta, any other kid Gohan

render.title: Render
render.description: sextant draws a finer fighter (2x3 pixels a cell); halfblock (1x2) is for a font without sextant glyphs

attacks.title: Attacks
attacks.description: A finished turn fires the fighter's signature beam (Kamehameha, Final Flash, Masenko) before the thumbs up
